name: find-everything
title: Find Everything
description: Instant Spotlight-free file search: persistent fd index, rg filter, fzf ranking. Finds more than Spotlight ever did.
author: supersynergy

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Find Everything
commands.subtitle: better than Spotlight
commands.description: Fuzzy-search indexed files and folders without Spotlight.

preferences.name: includeHidden
preferences.title: Include Hidden Files
preferences.label: Index dotfiles and hidden directories
preferences.description: When enabled, fd scans hidden files too (configs, dotfiles).

preferences.name: includeIgnored
preferences.title: Include Ignored Files
preferences.label: Ignore .gitignore/.ignore rules
preferences.description: When enabled, files excluded by .gitignore are indexed too. Larger index.

preferences.name: extraExcludes
preferences.title: Extra Excludes
preferences.description: Comma-separated fd exclude patterns on top of the built-in defaults.

preferences.name: customSearchPaths
preferences.title: Custom Search Paths
preferences.description: Comma-separated absolute directories for the Custom scope.

preferences.name: indexMaxAgeMinutes
preferences.title: Index Max Age (min)
preferences.description: Index older than this is rebuilt in the background on open.
